verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents a free sandbox that needs no credit card or billing account, plus a free monthly tier of 1 TiB of queries and 10 GiB of storage. That gives a no-cost cloud dev loop, but the sandbox is described as offering only 'limited BigQuery capabilities' for evaluation. The query dry-run cost estimate is a different feature and does not count as sandbox isolation. Missing for 10: a local engine or emulator for offline development, documented details of sandbox limits and how it isolates transformation development from production, and independent hands-on corroboration of a sandbox-based dev loop.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I get a fast local or free dev loop — a local engine, emulator, or sandbox — to develop transformations before touching production compute

citations.quote: The BigQuery sandbox lets you experience BigQuery without providing a credit card or creating a billing account for your project.
The BigQuery sandbox lets you explore limited BigQuery capabilities at no cost to confirm whether BigQuery fits your needs.
Store 10 GiB of data and run up to 1 TiB of queries for free per month.
